CLASSIFICATION::enable
       Deprecated: Enables classification for the current flow.

SYNOPSIS
       CLASSIFICATION::enable

DESCRIPTION
       This command enables classification for the current flow.

       CLASSIFICATION::enable

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
       CLASSIFY::enable replaces this command

SEE ALSO
       CLASSIFY::enable

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.  @BIGIP-12.0.0 -- Deprecated in favor of CLASSIFY namespace
